example.en: A different language is a different vision of life.
example.cn: 换一门语言，就是换一种看世界的方式。

example.en: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
example.cn: 走得慢不要紧，只要不停下。

example.en: It always seems impossible until it is done.
example.cn: 事情在做成之前，总显得不可能。

example.en: We are what we repeatedly do.
example.cn: 我们由自己反复做的事塑造。

example.en: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
example.cn: 成功是日复一日微小努力的总和。

example.en: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
example.cn: 种一棵树最好的时间是二十年前，其次是现在。

example.en: Great works are performed not by strength but by perseverance.
example.cn: 成就伟业靠的不是力量，而是坚持。

example.en: You do not have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.
example.cn: 你不必看清整段楼梯，先迈出第一步就好。

example.en: Little by little, one travels far.
example.cn: 一步一步，也能走得很远。

example.en: Learning is a treasure that will follow its owner everywhere.
example.cn: 学识是随身而行、永不褪色的财富。

example.en: The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
example.cn: 开始的办法，就是少说、动手做。

example.en: The only limit to our realization of tomorrow is our doubts of today.
example.cn: 通往明天的唯一阻碍，是今天的犹疑。
